'''Anthony Mornout''' (also published as '''Tony Mornout''')<ref name="dt-21616">[http://www.decktech.net/starwarsccg/deck/21616 Who  What  Where], DeckTech (Anthony "Old-schooler" Mornout, 20 February 2002). Preservation copies: [https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/21616/ Stephen Skilton]; [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/21616/ GitHub Pages].</ref> (DeckTech handle '''Old-schooler''') posted a [[Light]] [[Hidden Base / Systems Will Slip Through Your Fingers|Hidden Base]] list on DeckTech in February 2002. As Tony Mornout he played at [[February 2002 Lafayette tournament]] on 24 February 2002 with dark combat and [[Hidden Base / Systems Will Slip Through Your Fingers|Hidden Base]], according to Brian Fred's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d3405">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2002-02-26-lafayette-indiana-2-24-take-2d3405/ lafayette-indiana-2-24-take-2], DeckTech (john "comando" matrix, 26 February 2002). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2002-02-26-lafayette-indiana-2-24-take-2d3405/ GitHub Pages].</ref>
